days.title: Journey, Check-in & Walkable Town Sights
days.summary: Board the early morning KSRTC EV Power Plus bus from Kengeri to Madikeri. Check into Treebo Doha King right behind the station, relish traditional Kodava lunch, and discover Madikeri Fort and Raja's Seat under the evening valley mist.
checklist: Keep KSRTC PNR (KS22879177) and Gov IDs handy for bus conductor verification
Pack light breakfast/snacks or water bottle for the en route highway stop
Carry light rain jacket or windbreaker and comfortable walking shoes for town sightseeing
Keep physical cash handy for local Madikeri auto rides (approx ₹50-₹100 per ride)

timeline.title: Auto/Cab to Kengeri TTMC
timeline.description: Head out early from home to reach Kengeri TTMC Bus Stand well ahead of the 06:20 AM boarding time.

timeline.title: Board KSRTC EV Power Plus (Bengaluru to Madikeri)
timeline.description: Board KSRTC EV Power Plus (TripCode: 0530BNGMRC, PNR: KS22879177, Seats: 13, 14) from Kengeri TTMC. Enjoy scenic smooth ride with breakfast highway stop en route.

timeline.title: Arrival at Madikeri & Walk to Hotel
timeline.description: Alight at Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand. Stroll 200–300 meters behind the station to Treebo Doha King. Complete check-in or drop luggage at reception if room cleaning is ongoing.

timeline.title: Authentic Kodava Lunch
timeline.description: Savor authentic Coorg delicacies like Akki Roti, Bamboo Shoot curry, or Coorg gravies at Taste of Coorg or Hotel Capitol in town.

timeline.title: Auto to Madikeri Fort
timeline.description: Take a short 5-minute auto ride up the road to Madikeri Fort (approx 1.2 km).

timeline.title: Explore Madikeri Fort & Museum
timeline.description: Walk through 17th-century stone ramparts, photograph life-sized stone elephant sculptures at the inner entrance, and tour the historical museum housed within the former St. Mark's church.

timeline.title: Walk / Auto to Raja's Seat
timeline.description: Proceed ~1 km south along the panoramic scenic ridge road toward Raja's Seat.

timeline.title: Sunset, Valley Vistas & Musical Fountain at Raja's Seat
timeline.description: Relax in manicured royal seasonal flower gardens, watch the golden sunset dip behind the layers of rolling Western Ghats mist, and enjoy the musical fountain at dusk.

timeline.title: Evening Spice & Coffee Bazaar Stroll
timeline.description: Stroll down through College Road / Main Market bazaar. Pick up roasted Arabica and Robusta filter coffee powder, fresh spices, and homemade artisan chocolates.

timeline.title: Dinner & Unwind at Hotel
timeline.description: Enjoy a comforting dinner at a town eatery or hotel restaurant before returning to Treebo Doha King for a restful night.

days.title: 4x4 Jeep Safari, Waterfalls & Coffee Plantation Walk
days.summary: Venture out on an early-morning 4x4 off-road jeep safari to Mandalpatti Peak above Pushpagiri Wildlife Sanctuary. Head to Abbey Falls amidst lush green coffee and pepper plantations, followed by an aromatic guided plantation walk.
checklist: Wear warm windcheaters or jackets for the breezy open 4x4 jeep safari
Wear sturdy walking shoes with good traction for wet rocky pathways around Abbey Falls
Carry ₹2,500 - ₹3,000 cash for the private 4x4 jeep driver and forest checkpost fee
Keep phone and cameras charged for mountain panoramic viewpoints

timeline.title: Early Wakeup & Morning Coffee
timeline.description: Wake up to brisk mountain air, grab hot local filter coffee, and prepare for the sunrise jeep safari.

timeline.title: Board 4x4 Off-Road Jeep to Mandalpatti Peak
timeline.description: Walk to the private jeep stand near the bus station. Board an authorized 4x4 jeep for an exhilarating off-road ride ascending toward the windswept grasslands of Mandalpatti.

timeline.title: Mandalpatti Peak Summit & Cloud Vistas
timeline.description: Witness 360-degree panoramic views overlooking the Pushpagiri Wildlife Reserve shrouded in morning mist and clouds. Enjoy fresh morning mountain breeze.

timeline.title: Scenic Jeep Descent to Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Ride down the rugged ghat tracks transitioning onto smooth estate roads winding directly toward Abbey Falls.

timeline.title: Abbey Falls Exploration & Hanging Bridge
timeline.description: Walk down the scenic shaded pathway lined with tall pepper vines, cardamom plants, and coffee bushes. Experience the thunderous 70-ft cascade from the suspension bridge.

timeline.title: Jeep Return to Madikeri Town
timeline.description: Jeep drops you back at the town center / bus stand. Walk over to your hotel room to freshen up.

timeline.title: Hearty Lunch & Afternoon Rest
timeline.description: Relish a hearty South Indian lunch at Hotel Mayura Valley View or local town eatery, followed by an hour of afternoon rest.
timeline.location: Hotel Mayura Valley View / Town Restaurant

timeline.title: Auto to Coffee & Spice Estate
timeline.description: Hire an auto for a short 10-minute ride along Abbey Falls Road / Stuart Hill outskirts.

timeline.title: Guided Coffee Plantation Tour
timeline.description: Take a guided estate walking tour through Arabica and Robusta plantations. Learn about coffee harvesting, roasting, cardamom, pepper vines, and vanilla cultivation.

timeline.title: Evening Cafe & Sunset Relaxation
timeline.description: Relax at Big Cup Cafe or Ainmane Cafe with specialty estate coffees, fresh passion-fruit beverages, and snacks.

timeline.title: Traditional Coorg Dinner
timeline.description: Have an intimate dinner enjoying local delicacies such as Kadambuttu (steamed rice dumplings) and Pandi/Veg curries.

additionalBudget.title: Forest Department Mandalpatti Entry & Eco Tax

timeline.title: Warm Hotel Breakfast
timeline.description: Wake up at a leisurely pace and enjoy a hot breakfast at the hotel to wait out early morning mist or heavy rainfall.

timeline.title: Covered Cab to Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Instead of an open 4x4 jeep to rugged mountain ridges, hire a covered closed cab to visit Abbey Falls.

timeline.title: Abbey Falls Sightseeing
timeline.description: Enjoy the dramatic roaring waterfall from the covered viewpoints and hanging suspension bridge.

timeline.title: Lunch at Taste of Coorg
timeline.description: Comfortable indoor dining in town enjoying traditional Kodava delicacies.

timeline.title: Indoor Coffee Processing & Tasting Experience
timeline.description: Visit Ainmane Specialty Coffee & Experience Center to taste monsooned Malabar blends and learn roasting techniques indoors.

timeline.title: Indoor Honey & Spice Museum Tour
timeline.description: Explore Coorg Honey & Spices display emporiums to sample pure Coorg wild honey, homemade wines, and organic spices.

timeline.title: Evening Tea & Warm Dinner
timeline.description: Return early to the hotel, relax with hot coffee, and enjoy room service or nearby dining.

days.title: Historic Temples, Check-out & 1:30 PM Departure
days.summary: Visit the 1820 Omkareshwara Swamy Temple and historic Gaddige (Raja's Tomb). Complete checkout at Treebo Doha King, finish spice purchases, have an early lunch, and board the 01:30 PM KSRTC Airavat Club Class bus back to Bengaluru.
checklist: Complete hotel checkout by 10:45 AM (official checkout is 11:00 AM) and leave bags at reception storage
Carry KSRTC return ticket (PNR: KS22879259, Seat: 5, 6) on phone
Pack spices, coffee powder, and chocolates securely in luggage before checkout
Reach Madikeri Bus Stand by 01:00 PM (30 minutes ahead of departure)

timeline.title: Morning Breakfast at Hotel
timeline.description: Have a wholesome breakfast at the hotel to fuel up for the morning temple visit.

timeline.title: Auto to Omkareshwara Temple
timeline.description: Take a 5-minute auto ride from the hotel to the ancient Omkareshwara Swamy Temple.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Omkareshwara Temple

timeline.title: Darshan & Fish Feeding at Omkareshwara Temple
timeline.description: Experience morning serenity at this 1820-era temple showcasing Gothic and Islamic dome architecture. Feed freshwater fish in the central temple kalyani (water tank).

timeline.title: Auto to Raja's Tomb (Gaddige)
timeline.description: Take an auto northward toward Mahadevpet to visit the historic Gaddige complex.

timeline.title: Explore Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Tour the peaceful Indo-Saracenic royal mausoleums of the Kodagu kings (Lingarajendra II and Doddaveerarajendra) situated in manicured garden grounds.

timeline.title: Auto Return & Hotel Check-out
timeline.description: Return to Treebo Doha King before 10:45 AM to pack up and complete check-out. Safely deposit luggage with reception front desk.

timeline.title: Final Town Market Shopping
timeline.description: Walk to the bazaar directly behind the bus stand to finish any remaining spice, coffee bean, and homemade wine purchases.

timeline.title: Early Comforting Lunch
timeline.description: Have an early lunch right next to the bus station at Udupi The Veg or Hotel Mayura to avoid any travel rush.
timeline.location: Udupi The Veg / Near Bus Stand

timeline.title: Collect Bags & Walk to Bus Stand
timeline.description: Retrieve stored bags from Treebo Doha King lobby and take a short 2-minute walk to Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand platform.

timeline.title: Board KSRTC Airavat Club Class to Bengaluru
timeline.description: Board KSRTC Airavat Club Class bus (TripCode: 1002MNGBNG, PNR: KS22879259, Seats: 5, 6) departing at 13:30 hrs toward Bengaluru.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri / Bengaluru
timeline.description: Arrive comfortably back in Bengaluru (Kengeri TTMC / Satellite Bus Stand) avoiding late-night highway traffic.

timeline.title: Cab/Auto Back Home
timeline.description: Board local cab or auto from Kengeri to return home safely.

activities.notes: Hired from private jeep stand near Madikeri bus station. Half-day off-road mountain safari & Abbey Falls circuit.
